MINISTRY OF HEALTH National Expanded Programme on Immunization GOVERNMENT OF UGANDA Vision To ensure that the Ugandan population is free of vaccine-preventable diseases Mission Goal To contribute to the overall objective of the HSDP in reducing morbidity, mortality and disability due to vaccine preventable diseases, so that they are no longer of public health importance To ensure that every child and high-risk group is fully vaccinated with high quality and effective vaccines against the target diseases according to recommended strategies
